name: Slavic Wave Porto
description: Experience a vibrant night of Slavic music and dancing. This special event is designed to create a fun, high-energy sense of community.
longDescription:
Slavic Wave Porto is a nightlife event held at Pinkclub on May 24, 2026. This special evening is dedicated to showcasing music and dance from Slavic cultures. The event aims to foster a collective atmosphere through shared cultural expression.

Attendees can expect an evening of energetic music suitable for dancing. The event is designed for individuals interested in Slavic cultural elements within a club setting. Pinkclub provides an indoor venue for the duration of the event.

Ticket prices vary, and further details regarding purchase will be available closer to the date. Pinkclub is located in Porto, accessible via public transport. Specific directions from Trindade metro station will be provided by the venue.
